title: 第3章 我最信守承诺了第4章 异世界的降临
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
眼瞅着林恩就要一起来。
“等一下！你到底想要干什么？！”
那个女武神紧咬银牙，终于是忍不住地质问。
林恩睁着死鱼眼，拿着烙铁在她的面前晃悠，晃悠的她心颤，道：
“我十年前不是说了吗？只要你乖乖地告诉我这里的情况，我就放了你，但是你就是不配合，那我当然也就没有别的办法了啊！”
那个女武神死死地盯着他。
“我也想要问你，你到底是什么？为什么十年来，你一直都杀不死？！”
林恩扶了扶眼球。
“这我也早就和你说了，我也不知道我什么被你切成了片片还能活，但你就是不听，那我也没有什么办法。”
那个女武神冰冷道：
“你是亚空间的邪神？亦或者是某个大魔的遗褪？还是其他的什么东西？！”
林恩一愣。
他望着自己手里的神器。
不对吧。
按理来说，不应该是我来审问你吗？你还叭叭地问上了！我要是知道，我还来问你？！
二话不说，林恩又给她堵住了。
“呜——！！”
那个女武神愤怒地挣扎，几乎恨不得将他撕碎。
因为触不及防间，又被他得逞了。
【叮！神泉纱夜对你的愤怒+10】

【叮！神泉纱夜对你的愤怒+10】
啪——
林恩又给她拔了出来，严肃道：
“老实点！先回答我的问题！我可以对着太阳发誓，只要你告诉我这里的情况，我立刻马上放了你，你应该也清楚我不是什么邪神，你觉得一个邪神能被你杀十年？！而且我口齿伶俐，三观端正，要不是你以貌取人，我会苦了吧唧算计你？！”
那个女武神喘息着，死死地愤怒地盯着他。
林恩继续敦敦善诱，冷笑道：
“而且，我可是观察了你很久，你每隔一段时间似乎不仅仅是需要回去那个太阳里面补充力量，好像你在里面还肩负着某种特殊的责任吧？我猜的对不对？”
那个女武神的双眼顿时微微一变，尽管她隐藏的很好，但还是被林恩捕捉到了。
毫无疑问。
她必须得定期回去，不然的话肯定会发生一些不好的事情。
林恩笑眯眯道：
“所以，你就当这是一个交易，你应该也看到了吧，我除了在这里之外，在其他地方根本就没有力量，你告诉我又能怎么样？”
“再说了，好歹也被杀了整整十年，多少也被杀出了一点感情吧！只要你告诉我，之后你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥，我们两不相犯，怎么样？”
说着，林恩抬起了手里的某术士神器。
“至于这个……”
啪——
林恩直接就丢到了身后。
他闭眼道：
“我虽然长得奇行种了一点，但是我堂堂正正，这种东西也只是为了吓唬你，我是不会用在你的身上的！”
那个女武神眯了眯眼，就像是在分辨他话里的真假。

“你确定？”
content_en:
Lin En was about to come with him.
"Wait a minute! What do you want to do?!"
The Valkyrie clenched her silver teeth and finally couldn't help but question.
Lin En opened his dead eyes and waved the soldering iron in front of her, which made her heart tremble and said:
"Didn't I say that ten years ago? As long as you tell me the situation here, I will let you go. But if you don't cooperate, then of course I have no other choice!"
The Valkyrie stared at him.
"I also want to ask you, who are you? Why have you been unable to be killed for ten years?!"
Linn adjusted his eyes.
"I've told you this a long time ago. I don't know why I can still live after being cut into pieces by you, but you just don't listen, so there's nothing I can do about it."
The Valkyrie said coldly:
"Are you the evil god of subspace? Or are you the remnant of a certain great demon? Or something else?!"
Linn was stunned.
He looked at the artifact in his hand.
That's not right.
Logically speaking, shouldn't I be the one to interrogate you? You even asked loudly! If I knew, would I still ask you? !
Without saying a word, Lin En blocked her again.
"Woo——!!"
The Valkyrie struggled angrily, almost wanting to tear him apart.
Because he couldn't reach the defense, he succeeded again.
【bite! Shenquan Saya's anger towards you +10】
[Ding! Shenquan Saya's anger towards you +10]
Snap——
Lin En pulled it out for her again and said seriously:
"Be honest! Answer my question first! I can swear to the sun that as long as you tell me what's going on here, I will let you go immediately. You should also know that I am not an evil god. Do you think an evil god can be killed by you for ten years?! And I am articulate and have good views. If you hadn't judged people by their appearance, I would have suffered a lot. Are you plotting against you?!"
The Valkyrie gasped and stared at him angrily.
Lin En continued to be seductive and sneered:
"Furthermore, I have been observing you for a long time. It seems that you not only need to go back to the sun to replenish your strength every once in a while, but also seem to have some special responsibilities there? Is my guess right?"
The Valkyrie's eyes suddenly changed slightly, and although she was well hidden, she was still caught by Lin En.
There is no doubt about it.
She had to go back regularly, otherwise something bad would definitely happen.
Lin En smiled and said:
"So, just think of this as a deal. You should have seen it, right? I have no power at all except here. What can I do if you tell me?"
"Besides, after all, I have been killed for a full ten years, and I think I have lost some emotion after being killed! As long as you tell me, you can take your Yangguan Road and I can cross my single-plank bridge, and we won't offend each other. How about that?"
With that said, Linn raised a certain warlock artifact in his hand.
"As for this..."
Snap——
Linn immediately threw it behind him.
He closed his eyes and said:
"Although I look a little strange, I am upright and upright. This kind of thing is just to scare you. I will not use it on you!"
The Valkyrie narrowed her eyes, as if trying to distinguish the truth from falsehood in his words.
"Are you sure?"
